title: Prove the sharp three-qubit Clifford tensor threshold T(3)=10
body:
The full Gaussian-dyadic three-qubit Clifford alphabet is pointwise tensor-independent exactly at widths **f >= 10**. This resolves the explicit three-qubit interval **7 <= T(3) <= 16** in PR5675/PR5967 and disproves extrapolating the one- and two-qubit value `4n+1` to n=3.

At width nine, the exact rank is **92,894,144** out of 92,897,280 projective operators: the only missing irreducible block has dimension 56, hence nullity **3,136**. A new transvection argument proves width-ten completeness without an even-sector character table. Any missing constituent would force a trace larger than the sixteen fixed quadratic-form spaces in either Pauli-character orbit permit. Schur products then prove all larger widths.

The package also gives an explicit central-idempotent null relation at nine, sufficient uniform Gram bounds `945/262144 <= eigenvalue <= 762615/32768` from ten onward, and the sufficient exact-phase fixed-residual window **10,11,12,13**. The spectral constants are not claimed sharp.

**Scope:** this is a native-algebra theorem, not a supplier or exponent improvement. Selected PR6030 remains at **kappa=0.003125804**, with its five inherited assumptions. The published character table of Lee–Yu–Peng–Lai (arXiv:2309.14850v2) is an explicitly cited mathematical input; it was not reconstructed from group multiplication.

**Review and validation:** CPython 3.12.2, standard library only.

- Two separate AI review/checking passes, with a written proof review and exact scientific hashes.
- All 4,489 published table entries independently matched against both HTML and original TeX.
- Primary quotient-character checker and separate direct 67-class character/literal-Pauli checker pass normally and under `-O`; rejecting controls included.
- Registered replay: `python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-three-qubit-threshold`.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight and 19-file Git-free export with all four declared predecessor inputs pass; both checkers replay normally and optimized without Git or network.
- Publication head: **f7f32a18dde54e67624a9ed9cc7e1b266d9585c0**. Scientific base and refreshed canonical main: **7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a**. Fork main is synchronized.
- Prepublication overlap records complete open-PR/discussion pagination and targeted all-state searches; no global literature-priority claim.

Only `research/clifford-three-qubit-threshold/` is added. The package records proof, data provenance, independent checks, overlap, validation, explicit scope change from the assigned card, and open next questions. No frozen source, shared code or selected frontier changed.

Credit: Ali Romman’s Clifford trace/pointwise framework, MatShep’s sharp small-qubit cases, Nick Petalas’s lower bound and open question, and Lee–Yu–Peng–Lai’s table. Prepared for alephnan with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; separate agent reviews are not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.
